arxiv-2207-14770.title: Informativity for centralized design of distributed controllers for networked systems
arxiv-2207-14770.creator: Jaap Eising, Jorge Cortés
arxiv-2207-14770.description: Abstract Recent work in data-driven control has led to methods that find stabilizing controllers directly from measurements of an unknown system. However, for multi-agent systems we are often interested in finding controllers that take their distributed nature into account. For instance, the full state might not be available for feedback at every agent.

arxiv-2208-01285.title: Evaluating Inter-Operator Cooperation Scenarios to Save Radio Access Network Energy
arxiv-2208-01285.creator: Xavier Marjou, Tangui Le Gleau, Vincent Messie, Benoit Radier, Tayeb Lemlouma, Gael Fromentoux
arxiv-2208-01285.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xavier Marjou, Tangui Le Gleau, Vincent Messie, Benoit Radier, Tayeb Lemlouma, Gael Fromentoux. Reducing energy consumption is crucial to reduce the human debt’s with regard to our planet. Therefore most companies try to reduce their energetic consumption while taking care to preserve the service delivered to their customers. To do so, a service provider (SP) typically downscale or shutdown part of its infrastructure in periods of low-activity where only few customers need the service.

arxiv-2211-13859.title: DATE: Dual Assignment for End-to-End Fully Convolutional Object Detection
arxiv-2211-13859.creator: Yiqun Chen, Qiang Chen, Qinghao Hu, Jian Cheng
arxiv-2211-13859.description: Abstract Fully convolutional detectors discard the one-to-many assignment and adopt a one-to-one assigning strategy to achieve end-to-end detection but suffer from the slow convergence issue. In this paper, we revisit these two assignment methods and find that bringing one-to-many assignment back to end-to-end fully convolutional detectors helps with model convergence.

Digital. Vernetzt.”. Joint project 6G-life, project identifica
arxiv-2305-03427.creator: Nurettin Turan, Benedikt Fesl, Wolfgang Utschick
arxiv-2305-03427.description: Abstract Recently, a versatile limited feedback scheme based on a Gaussian mixture model (GMM) was proposed for frequency division duplex (FDD) systems. This scheme provides high flexibility regarding various system parameters and is applicable to both point-to-point multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) and multi-user MIMO (MU-MIMO) communications.

arxiv-2309-01353.title: Real-time pedestrian recognition on low computational resources
arxiv-2309-01353.creator: Guifan Weng 1∗
arxiv-2309-01353.description: Abstract Pedestrian recognition has successfully been applied to security, autonomous cars, Aerial photographs. For most applications, pedestrian recognition on small mobile devices is important. However, the limitations of the computing hardware make this a challenging task. In this work, we investigate real-time pedestrian recognition on small physical-size computers with low computational resources for faster speed.

arxiv-2401-11838.title: The Conversation is the Command: Interacting with Real-World Autonomous Robot Through Natural Language DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3610978.3640723 Conference: Companion of the 2024 ACM/IEEE International Conference on Human-Robot Interaction; March 11–14, 2024; Boulder, CO, USA Companion of the 202
arxiv-2401-11838.creator: Linus Nwankwo, Elmar Rueckert
arxiv-2401-11838.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Linus Nwankwo, Elmar Rueckert. In recent years, autonomous agents have surged in real-world environments such as our homes, offices, and public spaces. However, natural human-robot interaction remains a key challenge. In this paper, we introduce an approach that synergistically exploits the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and multimodal vision-language models (VLMs) to enable humans to interact naturally with autonomous robots through conversational dialogue.

arxiv-2501-03678.title: Effects of energetic particles produced by magnetic reconnection on discs of young stars
arxiv-2501-03678.creator: Brunn Valentin
arxiv-2501-03678.description: Abstract See pages - of FrontPageUM.pdf Abstract T Tauri stars, young analogues of Sun-like stars, are surrounded by protoplanetary discs of dust and gas. These stars and their discs are crucial for understanding stellar evolution and the formation of planets in low-mass systems. These stars exhibit significant variability, notably emitting intense X-ray flares due to magnetic reconnection events.

arxiv-2511-15146.title: Beyond Uncertainty Sets: Leveraging Optimal Transport to Extend Conformal Predictive Distribution to Multivariate Settings
arxiv-2511-15146.creator: Eugene Ndiaye
arxiv-2511-15146.description: Abstract Conformal prediction (CP) constructs uncertainty sets for model outputs with finite-sample coverage guarantees, all without distributional assumptions other than exchangeability. A candidate output is included in the prediction set if its non-conformity score is not considered extreme relative to the scores observed on a set of calibration examples.

pmc-11376568.title: Cell-intrinsic regulation of phagocyte function by interferon lambda during pulmonary viral, bacterial super-infection
pmc-11376568.creator: Danielle Antos, Olivia B. Parks, Alexis M. Duray, Nevil Abraham, Joshua J. Michel, Saran Kupul, Rosemary Westcott, John F. Alcorn, Kanta Subbarao, Jacob S. Yount, Kanta Subbarao, Jacob S. Yount, Kanta Subbarao, Jacob S. Yount, Kanta Subbarao, Jacob S. Yount

Primary influenza infection has been shown to increase susceptibility to secondary methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) infection by altering the host immune response, leading to significant immunopathology.

pmc-12831769.title: Fear of Negative Evaluation among College Students during the COVID-19 Pandemic: The Role of Adverse Childhood Experiences and Anxiety Sensitivity
pmc-12831769.creator: Francesca A. St. Pe, Isabella K. Pallotto, Jacquana L. Smith, Angela Combs, Abigail McCarthy, Zoey Bass, Cathleen C. Odar Stough
pmc-12831769.description: Fear of negative evaluation (FNE) impacts adolescent young adult (AYA) college students’ mental health through impaired academic and social performance. Adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) are prevalent among college students and may play a role in exacerbating FNE symptoms. Early life stressors are associated with anxiety sensitivity (AS) which may contribute to the development or worsening of FNE.

pmc-12980911.title: Bioorthogonal catalytic centres engineered for gastrointestinal stabilization provide oral delivery for the treatment of gastric cancer
pmc-12980911.creator: Muthu Kumaraswamy Shanmugam, Girish Vallerinteavide Mavelli, Pang Yuze, Hrucha Shielesh Damle, Leroy Sivappiragasam Pakkiri, Lik Hang Wu, Lim Poh Leong, Siddhesh Sujit Vaidya, Samira Sadeghi, Gautam Sethi, Chester Lee Drum
pmc-12980911.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundGastric cancer, the fifth most prevalent cancer globally, poses significant treatment challenges due to factors such as late diagnosis, early metastasis, limited surgical options, and the systemic toxicity of chemotherapy. Because luminal barriers are often compromised in gastric cancers , orally administered therapies that enable localized absorption and drug release represent a promising new direction for site-specific treatment with limited side effects.ResultsWe introduce a disulfide-linked thermostable exoshell system that orally delivers protein-based bioorthogonal catalytic centres directly to cancer tissues.

pmc-13298756.title: Design of an artificial intelligence model to screen spontaneous speech to detect Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-13298756.creator: Kenneth M. Madden, Boris Feldman, Daniel Jimenez, Mandeep Khokhar, Qihan Li, Minh Nguyen, Jian Zhu
pmc-13298756.description: There is a shortage of physicians trained in the specialized care of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). One possible solution is to use machine learning (ML)/artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to screen for the effects of AD on speech patterns, a technique that has the potential for automation.
